faqs.a:
A person commits the crime of criminal tampering with a service if, with intent to
               cause interruption or impairment of a service rendered to the public by a utility
               or by an institution providing health or safety protection, the person tampers with
               property of a utility or institution.
(Ord. No.
4847
, § 2, 7-10-2023)
